rubric.pt: powder has a larger surface area
more particles exposed, so more collisions per second
so more successful collisions / faster rate

prac.model: The powder has a much larger surface area, so more particles of calcium carbonate are exposed to the acid. There are more collisions per second, so more successful collisions and a faster rate.
